items.title: Milton Batiste Interview, 1997-02-05
items.q: I started playing with Smiley Lewis. ... Played with Smiley for a long time. ... We played with Smiley.

ctx.x: So how often did you go out on the road? I mean, was this for how many years?

I actually didn't start going on the road until the very late, late 50s, middle 50s, 55. That's when it really started going on the road for me. Otherwise it was like, I call it going on the road when we started going to places like Meridian, Mississippi, Club Alley, Michigan, Alabama, and Birmingham, and stuff like that. Anything over 200, 300 miles from home than we were on the road. Mm-hmm. But I mean, going up to Vashery and places on the River Road, it's just local. Yeah. We played a lot of that. When we…
